ctx.x: So I never got very much about that. The only thing I knew he used to speak about, he used to show me his old books of harmony, and tell me this and that and the other and so forth. And he could harmonize in any key you want, any key. And part is a soft way, you know what I'm saying? You could be singing here and you'd change key and everything else, he'd tell you the key you changed to. All he wanted to know, where you began. Yeah. He'd get, he'd get an idea of a keynote of what key you're singing in. He'd give…

We called him Lanky, young teal. We called him Lanky. But he wasn't there. He wasn't an old man Lorenzo's only son. He had brothers and sisters. Maybe some more. They may be still over there in Basinless or Pasquale, whatever place you lived in Mississippi. They may be still there. Or even over here.
